messages:
ada: quick q — thinking about per-route log granularity. teams want full req/resp for canaries but we keep hitting quota and sometimes surface PII. can we design a "redaction budget" or a soft quota so debug sessions don't ruin telemetry or billing? cc @raj @morgan

raj: +1. we should separate two axes: cost (tokens/requests) and privacy risk. budget idea makes sense — something like `redaction_budget` that decrements on sampled unredacted captures.

morgan: my main worry is sampling + small samples -> higher chance to leak identifiable fields since we pick rare examples. if we allow full captures for a route, we need stronger guardrails: enforced field masks + ops approval.

kevin: proposal sketch: per-route config with three knobs: `capture_level` (none/min/fields/full), `redaction_budget` (monthly token budget), `risk_threshold` (0-100). fallback to masked if budget exhausted.

ada: rough YAML snippet i mocked for console API — happy to iterate:

```yaml
route: /v1/respond
capture_level: fields
redaction_budget: 20000 # tokens / month
risk_threshold: 60
allow_canary_full_capture: true
```

raj: love it. for auditing we'd emit metrics: `redaction_budget_used`, `budget_exhausted`, `auto_masked_events`. telemetry-bot can pick those up.

telemetry-bot: noted — creating metrics: ["redaction_budget_used", "redaction_budget_exhausted", "route_auto_masked_count"] and a backend tag `route=<route>` for aggregation.

morgan: UX question: how does console surface remaining budget so PMs/engineers don't get surprised? could we have a per-route gauge + alert thresholds? also show an "estimated risk" per capture based on heuristics (PII score).

kevin: + show estimated tokens per capture and running monthly projection. something like: `estimated_tokens_this_month = average_tokens * projected_requests` and a small red/yellow/green status.

ada: ops-flow: if a team requests temporary full capture for a canary, require 2-approver flow and a TTL (e.g., 24h) that consumes budget and flips back automatically. ops-bot should record who approved.

ops-bot: deployed canary feature-flag `route-debug-granularity` to staging. approval flow wired to /internal/approvals. will post audit log for every temporary full capture.

raj: implementation notes: runtime needs to check budget atomically and update counters on capture. avoid per-request DB roundtrip — use token-bucket on a sharded cache. if cache miss, fallback to masked capture and enqueue async decrement repair.

morgan: one more: sampling semantics when `capture_level=fields` — define canonical field masks (email, ssn, credit_card) and allow route override list. we should ship a default mask set that covers obvious PII.

ada: ok action items: 1) eng-platform to prototype config + token-bucket budget (kevin, raj) 2) telemetry to add metrics and a small console widget (telemetry-bot, morgan) 3) ops to wire approval TTL + audit logging (ops-bot) 4) product to write short policy for teams that request full captures (ada).

kevin: i'll open a short RFC with the config shape and runtime sketch by EOD Monday.

morgan: if anyone's on standup tomorrow i'll demo the console mockups — they include projected spend + risk band per-route.

ada: thanks all. :thumbsup:

kevin: ack.

raj: noted, will sync with infra on sharded token-bucket.

telemetry-bot: metric tickets created: #T-4321 #T-4322

morgan: closing loop — please add any missing edge-cases to the RFC thread once it's up.

ada: will do."
